critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~2700+ lines (auth, security, contacts, team hierarchy, agent, provider, webhooks, sync, seed all in one file). Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth_router.py, team_router.py, agent_router.py, provider_router.py, webhooks_router.py, admin_router.py) — files >700 lines violate the size guideline.

POST /api/team — when reports_to is provided but the target role is national_manager and reports_to is NOT the master admin, the code path lands in 'elif expected is None' which is unreachable for national_manager (expected_parent is None only for national_manager). The branch is currently structured so a national_manager with a non-master parent fails with the wrong message path. Verified at runtime returns 400, but the error string is implicit. Minor — consider a clearer dedicated branch.

PATCH /api/team/{id} — cycle check correctly walks up via reports_to but does NOT cap the walk depth; combined with the role-tier guard the practical depth is ≤5, but defensive `for _ in range(50)` would prevent any future loop on corrupt data (currently relies on visited set, which is fine).

_enrich_member runs ONE Mongo round-trip per member to fetch manager + one count_documents. GET /api/team enriches every member sequentially in a list comprehension — for ~50 users that's ~100 round-trips. Consider a single $lookup aggregation or batching manager lookups by id.

delete_team_member sets subordinates' reports_to=null but does NOT cascade-validate their role tier — orphaned ZMs/AMs are left dangling with reports_to=null which then violates strict hierarchy on the next PATCH. Acceptable for now (the UI surfaces them as 'no manager') but consider auto-reattaching to the deleted member's parent or flagging them.

Master Admin is still subject to the forced /security-setup gate on the FE (carry-over). The backend exposes security_setup_required=true on _safe_user with no is_master_admin bypass — confirm with product whether admin should be exempt.

POST /api/team/{id}/feedback allows author_role='admin' for the master admin and stores normalize_role(current.get('role') or 'admin') — for the master admin role is 'admin' so this is fine. But for a national_manager posting feedback on a subordinate the role pill will correctly show 'national_manager'. Verified.

They were not found in the DOM after Send OTP, so OTP fill + verify click never executed, the password step never appeared, and subsequent /team navigation was rejected back to /login (RequireAuth). Suggested fix: open /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx (or equivalent) and either confirm the existing testids on the OTP step or add login-otp-input + login-verify-otp-btn on the OTP <input> and verify button.
